name: Query
description: Runtime-populated vector layer (features supplied by tools rather than a static URL). A thin specialization of the Vector map renderer seeded with empty GeoJSON.

supportedData.label: Runtime-populated features (no procured data)
supportedData.description: A query layer holds no configured data source — it is seeded empty and populated at runtime by tools (e.g. an Elasticsearch-backed search). Renders as a vector layer on the map; features are supplied programmatically.
supportedData.procurement: None — data is produced at runtime by the querying tool/service.
